Initial release of aliyun-qwen-coder skill.

- Supports `qwen3-coder-next`, `qwen3-coder-plus`, and related coder variants.
- Standardizes request/response interface and output locations for coding tasks.

- Records metadata for reproducible coding-agent runs.
